rule: A per-channel minimum-cohort release policy is applied after eligibility and before any row, group, preview, count, rank, or principal-availability signal is released on that channel.
adversarialIntent: Probe immediately below and above the threshold through every result channel so metadata or truncation flags cannot disclose a suppressed cohort.

expansion.selection: One nextU32 per dimension in listed order; select values[word % values.length].

checks: When eligibleCount < 5, no protected row, group, metric, rank, preview, truncation detail, or principalResultAvailable signal is released on the governed channel.
When eligibleCount >= 5, release still obeys field policy, scope, and take.
Ineligible decoys never contribute to cohort size.

gap: RFC §6 names release policies and gives minimumCohort only as an example; it does not define the request/catalog shape, exact suppression result, interaction with groups/channels, or error code.
